existing_data_analyses.label: Analyses of already-frozen sc30-sc54 outputs — no new simulation required

B1_absolute_capacity_levels.description: Absolute capacity levels at r=1.25 for all 7 policies
B1_absolute_capacity_levels.floor_handling: Report n_right_censored from policy_summaries; floor-at-zero cells are those with C_lower=0 and C_upper>0; base-infeasible cells are both [0,0]
B1_absolute_capacity_levels.bracket_width_summary: Exclude [0,0] base-infeasible cells from bracket-width aggregates

B2_binding_constraints.description: Which constraint (B=thermal, S=thermal-severity, B_cab=cabinet-power) binds at crossing for each policy at r=1.25
B2_binding_constraints.label: legacy_cabinet_reference_binding_diagnostic
B2_binding_constraints.note: Cabinet reference is legacy job-contribution P99 (per_cabinet_p99_kW_correct from cabinet_power_envelopes.json). B_cab_ratio reported per scenario.

B3_fpspread_vs_fp_both_directions.description: FPSpread vs FP and FP vs FPSpread both directions with paired bootstrap CI

B4_sign_tests_holm.description: Exact sign tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction for all 8 r=1.25 comparisons
B4_sign_tests_holm.note: Directional sign test; ties (indistinguishable verdicts) treated as 0.5 under null, recorded separately

B5_decomposition_contrasts.description: Exploratory decomposition contrasts to separate sources of FP advantage

contrasts.name: global_score_advantage
contrasts.interpretation: advantage from knowing thermal ordering globally

contrasts.name: node_vs_cabinet_level
contrasts.interpretation: advantage from node-specific identity beyond cabinet-level composition

B5_decomposition_contrasts.label: exploratory — not preregistered

B6_order_statistic_median_intervals.description: Order-statistic confidence intervals for median delta_lo (n=25)
B6_order_statistic_median_intervals.method: exact binomial order statistics OS_8 and OS_18 for 95% CI on median (n=25)
B6_order_statistic_median_intervals.note: Bootstrap CI is primary; OS interval is a non-parametric confirmation

B7_sc5_sc29_evaluation.description: Earlier held-out sc5-sc29 evaluation at r=1.25 using frozen revision1 outputs
B7_sc5_sc29_evaluation.note: sc5-sc29 used revision1 selectors (no position_template, no placebos); comparisons limited to FP_vs_Random, FP_vs_Loc, FPSpread_vs_FP. Reported as context only — not a new pre-registered endpoint.
B7_sc5_sc29_evaluation.label: exploratory context, revision1 design

cabinet_reference_audit.label: Task C — document legacy cabinet envelope construction
cabinet_reference_audit.legacy_method: Uniform node-power approximation: P_cab_j = (mean_power_j / node_count_j) * n_nodes_in_cab_j using CORRECT topology. Applied to all jobs with reported mean_power > 0. P99 taken over all qualifying job contributions.
cabinet_reference_audit.key_distinction: Legacy P99 is computed over job-level contributions (one value per job-cabinet pair); it is NOT the same statistical object as concurrent cabinet power averaged over time. These are different estimators of cabinet thermal/power capacity.

cabinet_support_audit.label: Task D — determine support for concurrent cabinet power reconstruction
cabinet_support_audit.definition: observed reconstructed concurrent cabinet power — the value computed from jobs that overlap in time within a cabinet, using the uniform node-power approximation

cabinet_reference_modes.label: Task F — three cabinet-reference definitions (frozen, no simulation yet)

F1_legacy_job_contribution_p99.name: legacy_job_contribution_p99
F1_legacy_job_contribution_p99.description: Current production definition. P99 of per-job cabinet power contributions over all 152,400 jobs. Used in all sc0-sc54 results.

F2_corrected_timeweighted_total_p99.name: corrected_timeweighted_total_p99
F2_corrected_timeweighted_total_p99.description: Concurrent cabinet power time-weighted total: sum of simultaneous job power contributions at each time point, P99 over the support period. Requires D (support audit) to define the period.
F2_corrected_timeweighted_total_p99.status: definition frozen; computation deferred pending support audit

F3_corrected_eventweighted_total_p99.name: corrected_eventweighted_total_p99
F3_corrected_eventweighted_total_p99.description: Concurrent cabinet power event-weighted: P99 over job-start-event-weighted samples of concurrent power. Alternative to F2.
F3_corrected_eventweighted_total_p99.status: definition frozen; computation deferred pending support audit

cabinet_reference_modes.reporting_rule: All Round-3 policy simulation results must report: (1) which cabinet reference mode was used; (2) whether any legacy vs corrected discrepancy exists; (3) the post-exposure disclosure. Primary preregistered result (sc30-sc54) used F1 only.

severity_diagnostic.label: Task G — S_cab severity diagnostic (kWh above reference)
severity_diagnostic.metric: S_cab_kWh = sum over cabinets of max(0, P_reconstructed - P_reference) * duration_h
severity_diagnostic.purpose: diagnostic only — not a feasibility criterion or policy comparison endpoint
severity_diagnostic.note: Prepared as code only pending D (support audit)

power_validation.label: Task H — validate concurrent cabinet power computation
power_validation.condition: Only scenarios where all concurrent jobs have usable telemetry

e1_cabinet_scale_behavior.label: Task J — document E1 behavior explicitly
e1_cabinet_scale_behavior.current_behavior: CAB_SCALE multiplies each cabinet's P99 envelope by the scale factor, then reruns the simulator. This tests sensitivity to uniform over/underestimation of cabinet capacity. It is NOT a fixed-budget test.
e1_cabinet_scale_behavior.historical_b_cab_denominators: For each scale factor, the denominator B_cab changes proportionally. Must be recorded in CABINET_REFERENCE_AUDIT.

threshold_population_audit.label: Task K
threshold_population_audit.exclusion_reason_source: to be determined from training data filtering in r1_m3_thermal_model.py or m4 scripts

legacy_T_thr_secondary.provenance: frozen in BETA_F calibration; source to be confirmed in r1_m3_thermal_model.py

floor_left_censor_rule.label: Task L — frozen floor/left-censor handling rule

base_infeasible.definition: C_lower = 0 AND C_upper = 0; scenario is completely infeasible under this policy at this ratio
base_infeasible.treatment: Report as [0, 0]; exclude from bracket-width summary statistics; count separately

floor_at_zero.definition: C_lower = 0 AND C_upper > 0; scenario is left-censored but not completely infeasible
floor_at_zero.treatment: Report C_lower=0, C_upper as computed; include in delta_lo computation as delta_lo = 0 - C_upper_B (conservative)

floor_left_censor_rule.bracket_width_summary: Bracket-width summaries (mean, median, IQR) exclude [0,0] base-infeasible cells. N of excluded cells reported separately.

position_template_audit.label: Task M
position_template_audit.loc_fa_construction: Mean FA_2024 over all fp nodes sharing the same pos_key. NaN filled with global mean.

loo_position_score.description: For each node, compute position template score excluding that node (LOO). Fallback if LOO group is singleton: use cross-chassis average at same slot/board/node_pos.
fallback_levels: mean over same slot_board_nodepos across all chassis
mean over same slot_board across all chassis
loo_position_score.note: Freeze fallback rule before execution; compute rank correlation between fallback variants

placebo_and_seed_plan.label: Task N
placebo_and_seed_plan.placebo_scope: Placebo score permutation affects the selector score only. The thermal model (FA_2024, beta) is unchanged. The constraint checker uses actual node power (not permuted scores).
placebo_and_seed_plan.unit_test_required: Verify placebo_fa not passed to thermal model; add assertion in r3_selectors.py
placebo_and_seed_plan.seed_derivation: rng = np.random.default_rng(847291653); scen_seeds = [int(rng.integers(0, 2**31)) for _ in range(25)]; wl_seeds = [int(rng.integers(0, 2**31)) for _ in range(25)]

late_cabinet_plan.label: Task O
late_cabinet_plan.rationale: Late-commissioned cabinets (first appeared 2024-07-18 to 2024-11-22); coolest in fleet (FA mean -1.24 to -2.22); FP selector preferentially picks them; may overstate FP advantage
late_cabinet_plan.diagnostic: Compare FP vs Random with and without late-cabinet nodes in candidate pool. Not a re-run of preregistered analysis; labeled exploratory.

calendar_split_plan.label: Task P
calendar_split_plan.split_boundary_rule: median start_time of the 2637 frozen base-cohort test-set jobs
calendar_split_plan.split_boundary_status: exact timestamp to be computed from test-set job data before execution
calendar_split_plan.purpose: Assess temporal stability of FP advantage: first half vs second half of test period

interpretation_rules.label: Task R — frozen interpretation rules for all Round-3 analyses
interpretation_rules.primary_challenge_unchanged: sc30-sc54 challenge is pre-specified; Round-3 results do not modify or supersede it
interpretation_rules.legacy_vs_corrected: If corrected reference changes any comparison verdict, report both; discrepancy is a finding, not a correction of the primary result
interpretation_rules.late_cabinet: Late-cabinet exclusion results reported as sensitivity; if they change the sign of FP_vs_Random, this is a material finding requiring disclosure
interpretation_rules.loo_position: LOO Position is a robustness check; non-separation finding stands regardless of LOO variant
interpretation_rules.placebos: Placebo comparisons reported as preregistered secondary; no reinterpretation of primary endpoint
interpretation_rules.thresholds: p90/p95/p99 variants reported as exploratory threshold sensitivity
interpretation_rules.calendar_split: Calendar-split reported as exploratory temporal stability; if second-half sign reverses, disclose
interpretation_rules.post_exposure_disclosure: ALL Round-3 outputs must include: 'Post-exposure: this analysis was designed and executed after the sc30-sc54 primary results were observed. The design was not changed after primary results were available, but the work is exploratory and reviewer-requested.'
